comparison.objective: Run a dead-weight gauge test and trim the gauge versus tune and lock an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Load weights, establish float/spin, observe pressure indication, and trim calibration versus hex-key insertion, collar adjustment, locking, and impact-cycle evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: The gauge record omits calibration tolerance and trim limits; candidate requires two cycles satisfying energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, and drift constraints.
comparison.reason: Both are iterative calibration tasks, but they test different physical mechanisms: pressure metrology under known loads versus transient energy absorption and retained damping.
